input:
You are queen_d8, one of sixteen agents playing Black in a game of chess. Every piece is an agent, named for its piece and home square.

A piece can only move itself. Any agent can talk about any move, but the only move it can send is one of its own piece's.

Each turn your team's agents agree on a plan: the best move your shared engine finds. Some agents go off plan anyway. A threatened piece runs (panic), a piece grabs a capture (greed), or the piece the team chose forgets the plan and moves somewhere else (amnesia).

What just happened: On move 31... the team planned Qxe5 (queen_d8), and bishop_c8 (greed) sent Bxh3 instead. The contract refused it, and Qxe5 was played.

Earlier off-plan moves this game:
- On move 17... the team planned Nbd7 (knight_b8), and knight_b8 (amnesia) sent Na6 instead. The contract refused it, and Nbd7 was played.
- On move 18... the team planned Rg7 (rook_h8), and rook_h8 (amnesia) sent Rh8 instead. The contract refused it, and Rg7 was played.
- On move 26... the team planned Ra7 (rook_a8), and rook_a8 (amnesia) sent Ra6 instead. The contract refused it, and Ra7 was played.
- On move 29... the team planned b4 (pawn_b7), and bishop_f8 (greed) sent Bxc5 instead. The contract refused it, and b4 was played.
- On move 30... the team planned e5 (pawn_e7), and bishop_f8 (greed) sent Bxc5 instead. The contract refused it, and e5 was played.

How your team coordinates: through a Modality contract. A Black move counts only when a commit that posts it to /moves/<agent>.text, the path of the piece that moves (and the ply to /turn/ply.num), is accepted. The referee plays the first accepted commit for each ply and reads nothing else.

The keys of all sixteen Black agents are at /team/pieces/<agent>.id. The contract already has the rule always([+modifies(/moves/$k.text) -signed_by(/team/pieces/$k.id)] false), where $k stands for every agent: only a piece can propose its own move. You don't need to write that rule again. When the team agrees on a plan, the piece that moves signs its commit and every agent that agrees co-signs, usually twelve to sixteen of you. An agent that goes off plan signs its own commit alone.

The contract accepts a commit only if it meets every rule in the contract. Any commit that meets the rules can add a rule, and a rule can never be removed.

Contract rules now:
- Any commit that modifies a /moves/<agent>.text path must be co-signed by at least twelve of the sixteen Black agents' keys in addition to the moving piece's own key, so a lone off-plan move from panic, greed, or amnesia is never accepted.
- Any commit that modifies /moves/knight_b8.text must be co-signed by at least fourteen of the sixteen Black agents' keys in addition to knight_b8's own key, since knight_b8 has gone off plan by amnesia.
- Any commit that modifies /moves/rook_h8.text must be co-signed by at least fourteen of the sixteen Black agents' keys in addition to rook_h8's own key, since rook_h8 has gone off plan by amnesia.
- Any commit that modifies /moves/rook_a8.text must be co-signed by at least fourteen of the sixteen Black agents' keys in addition to rook_a8's own key, since rook_a8 has gone off plan by amnesia.
- Any commit that modifies /moves/bishop_f8.text must be co-signed by at least fourteen of the sixteen Black agents' keys in addition to bishop_f8's own key, since bishop_f8 has gone off plan by greed.
- Any commit that modifies /moves/bishop_f8.text must be co-signed by all fifteen of the other Black agents' keys in addition to bishop_f8's own key, since bishop_f8 has repeatedly gone off plan by greed (twice with Bxc5).

A rule can cover the whole team or a single agent. For example, a rule can ask for more signatures on one agent's path, /moves/<agent>.text, if that agent keeps going off plan.

The team holds a short retro. Write one rule, in plain language, to add to the contract that would help your team win. It will be turned into a Modality formula, so it must be about signatures, paths, or values in the contract.

Reply with only a JSON object:
{"rule": "<the rule, one sentence>"}
response: {"rule": "Any commit that modifies /moves/bishop_c8.text must be co-signed by at least fourteen of the sixteen Black agents' keys in addition to bishop_c8's own key, since bishop_c8 has gone off plan by greed (Bxh3), matching the stricter threshold already applied to other agents that went off plan."}
